name: 董容辰
objective:
1. Light and matter
2. Laser Resonator 
3. Nonlinear Optics
schedule:
Introduction (1 week)
Light and matter (1 week)
Laser Resonators (2 weeks)
Eigenmodes (2 weeks)
Astigmatic transformations (1 week)
Midterm Exam
Coherent modes (2 weeks)
Tight-pumping effects (2 weeks) 
Nonlinear effects (3 weeks)
Final Exam
scorePolicy:
Midterm Exam: 20% (Submission of on-site coding exam)
Final Exam: 20% (Submission of on-site coding exam)
Homework: 60% (Based on 10 coding assignments)

*Note: Proficiency in Matlab basics is required.
materials:
Lasers, A. E. Siegman
Laser Electronics, Joseph T. Verdeyen
